articles.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
articles.snippet: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

articles.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
articles.snippet: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
articles.snippet: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

articles.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
articles.snippet: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.snippet: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.
